diagnostics.message: Product nominal voltage 230.0 V differs from the GB/T test nominal 220.0 V.
diagnostics.recommendation: Keep the hardware rating, but use the separate GB/T nominal voltage for compliance testing.

diagnostics.message: The configured minimum efficiency is not proof of the GB/T ten-point average-efficiency result.
diagnostics.recommendation: Validate after 30 min warm-up at ten evenly spaced output-voltage points.

startup_inrush_test.label: Startup input-current test

startup_inrush_test.note: Microsecond EMI inrush is excluded by the standard.

current_error_voltage_points.label: DC current-error voltage points

ripple_scope_setting.label: External ripple-test oscilloscope

ac_protection_thresholds.label: AC over/undervoltage protection thresholds

vac_nominal_handling.label: AC nominal-voltage parameter
vac_nominal_handling.value: Add compliance test nominal; do not overwrite hardware/product rating
vac_nominal_handling.note: GB/T nominal=220.000 V RMS; test range=187.000–253.000 V RMS.

vac_range_handling.label: AC min/max voltage parameters
vac_range_handling.value: Keep wider hardware range; add separate GB/T test range

pf_handling.label: Power-factor parameter

efficiency_handling.label: Efficiency parameter
efficiency_handling.value: Keep worst-case sizing efficiency; add E1 average-efficiency threshold 0.94

vdc_accuracy_handling.label: VDC accuracy target
vdc_accuracy_handling.value: Keep sensing-chain target <=0.5%FS; standard whole-product limit is ±1%

idc_accuracy_handling.label: IDC accuracy target
idc_accuracy_handling.value: Keep sensing-chain target <=0.5%FS; add whole-product piecewise 5% / 0.5 A limits

ripple_handling.label: VDC ripple parameter
ripple_handling.value: Add 5% whole-product ripple test; do not replace ADC/RC bandwidth

scope_bandwidth_handling.label: 20 MHz oscilloscope bandwidth
scope_bandwidth_handling.value: External test-equipment setting only; do not map to F29H85x ADC bandwidth

inrush_handling.label: Startup current ratio
inrush_handling.value: Use 1.20 pu as a compliance range floor; retain larger overload/fault margin

phase_deviation_handling.label: Three-phase ±3° requirement
phase_deviation_handling.value: Add as grid test case; do not replace ADC inter-channel skew target

temperature_handling.label: Temperature parameters
temperature_handling.value: Separate vehicle ambient/storage tests from component -40…125 °C error-budget range

emc_handling.label: Surge/ESD/EFT requirements
emc_handling.value: Add transient withstand requirements; do not enlarge linear sensing range to kV values

dielectric_udmax_v.label: Highest working voltage used for dielectric test

esd_powered.label: Powered ESD
esd_powered.value: ±8 kV contact; ±15 kV air; ±20 kV indirect contact

diagnostics.message: VAC divider drives the isolation input to 1.432 V, beyond the ±1.000 V linear range.
diagnostics.recommendation: Increase high-side resistance/reduce divider ratio. Hardware redesign is required; software calibration cannot restore clipped data.

diagnostics.message: VAC isolation output exceeds ADC range.
